# Wallet Address Validator Kit full agent context

Canonical source: https://github.com/devdasx/wallet-address-validator-kit

This package validates blockchain wallet address syntax offline. It checks Base58Check checksums, Bech32/Bech32m checksums, CashAddr checksums, EIP-55 mixed-case checksums, HRPs, prefixes, and payload lengths.

Supported chains include Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Dash, DigiByte, Bitcoin Cash, Zcash transparent, Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, TRON, Solana, Cosmos, Osmosis, Juno, Terra, and Cardano Bech32 syntax.

Run:

```bash
npm test
examples/run-examples.sh
npm pack --dry-run
```

Do not add network calls for validation.
